name: The Visitor
source:
Poor Count Bela Blasko has a few issues. In addition to his dietary issues, he has family issues which include a few eccentric uncles, three cousins staying over while suspended from school, and two freeloading students working on a Science Project. He also has nosy neighbors, and Dating issues. Beyond that, he's a pretty normal guy -- for a vampire in the 1930s.


[From[url=http://www.renai.us/game/the_visitor.shtml] Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
可怜的贝拉·布拉斯科伯爵有一些问题。除了饮食问题外，他还有家庭问题，其中包括几个古怪的叔叔、三个休学期间留下来的表兄弟，以及两个从事科学项目的白费学生。他还有爱管闲事的邻居和约会问题。除此之外，对于20世纪30年代的吸血鬼来说，他是一个相当正常的人。


[来自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/the_visitor.shtml]仁爱档案[/url]]
